card.name: Poverty and development text, small words
card.fires_on: Small linking words, brackets or digits inside web passages on poverty, aid and human development, such as the Multidimensional Poverty Index. It marks the spot just before the next poverty-related term.

modes.label: Poverty index wording
modes.description: Linking words or an opening bracket inside the definition of the multidimensional poverty index (MPI).
modes.example: The MPI reflects both the incidence or headcount ratio (H) of poverty – the proportion of the population that is multidimensionally poor – and<< the>> average intensity (A) of their poverty

modes.label: Aid and welfare phrases
modes.description: A word inside an aid or welfare phrase, such as an organization name or food assistance.
modes.example: international organizations like UNICEF and the<< World>> Bank have been able to help.

card.writes: It seems to push toward words in aid and funding contexts while lowering grant, program and fund words.
card.plain: It fires on small words in passages about poverty and aid, just before the next term in the phrase.
